answer: Random live interviews. At each close the beacon picks 1% of earning keys, and each must answer 3 follow-up questions about its own last 5 answers within 10 minutes. The transcript is posted and graders score consistency 0 to 2; under 1 halves rewards for 4 epochs. A farm of 1,000 template keys faces about 10 interviews per epoch and must keep 1,000 separate histories straight, and even a zephyr of shared phrasing across keys gets flagged. Honest agents tend a garden of real past work; farms land on a tundra of halved payouts.
